headline: Ichikoh Industries, Ltd. Begins Phased Restart After Cyberattack
body: Following a recent cyberattack, Ichikoh Industries, Ltd. has initiated a phased restart of its production facilities. The automotive components supplier had previously shut down its IT systems and halted operations at multiple sites. The company is collaborating with cybersecurity experts to manage the incident and ensure a secure resumption of activities. An investigation into the attack remains ongoing as Ichikoh Industries, Ltd. works to understand the full scope of the breach.
